_metadata.description: One versioned revision driving the ingredient map, reading view, cooking mode, and validated method graph.

requirements.title: One revision drives map, read, and cook views
requirements.description: The scenario shall drive the recipe map, the conventional reading view, and the focused cooking mode from the same versioned recipe revision, and advancing the cooking view shall not mark food as eaten or completed.

validation.notes: Planned: all three tabs resolve the same revision and a step preview plus Next navigation leaves completion state unchanged (ACT-015).

requirements.title: The method is a validated dependency graph
requirements.description: Every step shall carry stable ID, title, instruction, dependencies, ingredient allocations, named outputs, optional duration, and equipment capabilities; dependencies shall form a DAG, and self-cycles, dangling references, duplicate outputs, and over-allocations shall be rejected with editable field paths.

validation.notes: Planned: FIX-05 renders the warm/prep branches and their combine join, and the negative variants (self-dependency, missing output, 60 g sauce against 40 g, duplicate output) fail with specific errors (ACT-013, ACT-014).

requirements.title: Allocations are counted once and dispositions are explicit
requirements.description: The scenario shall store multiple step allocations against a single ingredient use, count that ingredient exactly once in recipe totals, and require an explicit disposition for discarded, reserved, or processing-aid quantities rather than subtracting arbitrary retention percentages.

validation.notes: Planned: splitting 40 g of sauce into 30 g mixed plus 10 g reserved yields one 40 g ingredient row; referencing a named output does not re-add its nutrients (ACT-013).

requirements.title: The map communicates branches without erasing data
requirements.description: The recipe map shall show ordered action columns with dependency cues, group wide graphs into stages with horizontal scrolling confined to the map region, keep the ingredient column readable, and surface unlinked ingredients in a clearly labeled state without erasing them from nutrition or groceries.

validation.notes: Planned: an unmapped ingredient appears under Not linked to a step and still contributes to totals; inactive cells do not render as required form inputs (ACT-013).
Planned UI journey: inspect a wide multi-stage map on a narrow viewport and confirm no page-level horizontal scroll.

requirements.title: Scaling and alternate methods preserve canonical content
requirements.description: When a serving scale is selected, the scenario shall change displayed quantities and calculated totals without mutating the recipe's stored canonical yield or planned occurrence, and it shall not scale time, temperature, or batch feasibility linearly or round discrete items silently.

validation.notes: Planned: scaling to 1.5 servings leaves the stored recipe unchanged and does not multiply cooking time; a microwave and a stovetop variant are distinct reviewed methods and eligibility requires only one complete viable method (ACT-016, ACT-017).
